title: ActiveMQ MCP Server Implementation
description: Complete MCP server for Apache ActiveMQ with STOMP protocol and Jolokia REST API support. Provides tools for message operations, queue management, and monitoring.

title: US-001: Setup project structure and dependencies
description:
Initialize TypeScript project with MCP SDK and ActiveMQ client libraries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Package.json with all required dependencies (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, stompit, zod)
- [ ] TypeScript configuration with ES2022 target and NodeNext modules
- [ ] Project structure: src/index.ts, src/activemq-client.ts, src/tools/, src/types.ts
- [ ] Build script produces dist/index.js
- [ ] npm run build succeeds
- [ ] npm run typecheck passes (if configured)

title: US-010: Implement purge_queue tool
description:
Add tool to delete all messages from a queue via Jolokia REST API.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] purgeQueue() method in ActiveMQClient using Jolokia exec endpoint
- [ ] HTTP Basic Auth with ActiveMQ credentials
- [ ] Zod schema for purge_queue (queueName)
- [ ] Tool registered in ListToolsRequestSchema handler
- [ ] Tool handler in CallToolRequestSchema switch statement
- [ ] Returns success message with purged count
- [ ] npm run build succeeds
- [ ] npm run typecheck passes (if configured)

title: US-002: Implement ActiveMQClient base class
description:
Create ActiveMQClient class with connection management and configuration.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Connection configuration from environment variables (ACTIVEMQ_HOST, ACTIVEMQ_PORT, ACTIVEMQ_USERNAME, ACTIVEMQ_PASSWORD)

title: US-003: Implement MCP server skeleton
description:
Create MCP server with stdio transport and basic tool registration.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] MCP Server instance created in src/index.ts
- [ ] StdioServerTransport configured
- [ ] ListToolsRequestSchema handler registered (empty tools list initially)
- [ ] CallToolRequestSchema handler registered (error for unknown tools)
- [ ] Server connects and starts successfully
- [ ] Console output goes to stderr (not stdout)
- [ ] npm run build succeeds
- [ ] npm run typecheck passes (if configured)
